pages.text: Nova explosives are enormous, clean blasts that gather all the drops for you.$(br2)$(l)How to get them:$()$(br2)$(li)$(l)Nova Catalyst:$() shapeless TNT + Mobius Fuel, makes 2.$(li)$(l)Nova Cataclysm:$() shapeless Nova Catalyst + Aeternalis Fuel, makes 2.$(br2)$(l)Using them:$() light them like TNT. The Catalyst has a blast radius of $(l)16$(), the Cataclysm $(l)48$().

$(l)Hidden abilities$()$(br2)$(li)The blast does $(l)not$() create fire, so it will not burn down your base.$(li)Every block destroyed drops its loot, and all the drops are gathered and released together at the position of whoever lit the charge, instead of being scattered across the crater.$(li)The fuse is four times shorter than vanilla TNT, so you have about one second to get clear.$(li)Dispensers can fire both types.$(li)The Cataclysm is a great mining tool when you need a large area cleared quickly, and its gathered drops make cleanup easy.$(br2)$(l)Server settings:$() none specific.
